# Provenance

* `inputs.json`, `oem_input.oem`: synthetic, drawn by `generate.py inputs` from the seed fixed
  in `xval/spk-writer-spice/PREREGISTRATION.md`.
* `spice/*.bsp`: written by the NAIF SPICE Toolkit (CSPICE N0067 via spiceypy 8.3.0, MIT) from
  those inputs with `spkopn`, `dafac`, `spkw09`, `spkw13` and `spkcls`.
* `outputs/spice.json`: values computed by the same toolkit (`spkpvn`, `spkgeo`, `str2et`,
  `spkobj`, `spkcov`, DAF inventory routines) with the NAIF leapseconds kernel `naif0012.tls`.
* `kshana/`: regenerated by the test, not committed.

No SPICE code is included in or linked into Kshana; the toolkit is used only as an oracle.
